phrases.text: Fortnite is giving away the entire Item Shop for free. Here's how it works!
This season, every chest you open has a tiny chance to drop Pirate Shop Access.
Activate it, and for 14 days, everything that costs V-Bucks is free.
Skins, emotes, pickaxes, gliders. And you keep them forever.
Would you even know what to grab first?
Use code BAD in the Item Shop. It really helps the channel.
Thank you for watching! Follow for more daily content.
